description: Election Commission - Notice under Section 66A (1) Filling of a Vacancy in the office of members of the Panadura Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Panadura Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the resignation of a member and the nomination of a replacement through the established electoral procedures. This fits squarely within the Elections category (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections.
